_doc: Companions (ADR-0058), run by CompanionDirector / CompanionMind. enemy: the EnemyDef his body is (archetype companion, faction remand). camp: the POI def he waits at to be found, where in it he sits (offset [x, z] building-local, yaw deg) and the ranges he is placed / taken out at while not yet recruited. recruit_items: any one, given at his camp, recruits him; revive_items: any one revives him downed (hold E revive_hold s); each is consumed. *_health: the health fraction he is up with. follow: min / max m he keeps behind the player, run_beyond (runs to catch up), teleport_beyond (placed beside the player out of sight), engage (takes on Hollowed hunting within this of the player), leash (drops a fight this far from the player). guard: radius he engages within round the spot, leash. downed.seconds: bleed-out. lantern: the light he carries at night while following (his own: not registered with the stimulus fields, so it never shows the Hollowed the player). barks: status-bar lines per event (CompanionDef.BARKS).

defs.name: Ezra Vane
defs.description: An earlier Remand convict, a lineman before that. He can follow, hold a spot and guard it, and he fights.

recruited: Ezra: "That'll hold the leg. All right. I'm with you."
downed: Ezra is down. Hold E on him with a bandage or a first aid kit.
out: Ezra didn't get up. If he lives he'll find his way to your bed by dawn.
back: Ezra limped in at dawn. He's at your bed.
